description: Search the 777 cards by feeling, mood, era, technique or style name. Use it when someone names or describes a specific look, lens, film stock, light, palette, font or music style ("what does Portra 400 look like", "ring light macro", "Wes Anderson-style symmetry" finds Planimetric Tableau), to identify a named look ("Kodak Gold" finds Gold 200), to find a replacement for one card in a hand, or to browse one suit. Examples: {"query": "film noir"}, {"query": "90s camcorder"}, {"query": "cozy rainy", "suit": "color"}, {"query": "bossa nova", "suit": "score", "top": 3}. Returns ranked cards (id, suit, kind, name, what, example image). When nothing matches directly it says so and returns related styles or did-you-mean suggestions. For a full matched set of cards for a project use deal_hand instead.

query.description: A feeling, mood, era, technique or style name, e.g. "dreamy 70s summer", "anamorphic", "risograph", "lo-fi beats". Words after "no"/"not" count against a card.

suit.description: Optional filter. type = typefaces, camera = shots, moves, lenses and lighting, film = looks and mediums, color = palettes and grades, score = music styles, web = site motion and layout.

name: find_styles

error.description: Set instead of the fields above when the input was wrong.

kind.description: the kind within the suit, e.g. stock, light, move

suit.description: type, camera, film, color, score or web

what.description: one line: what the style is

title: Find styles
